candidates.angle: Kubera is the lord of wealth among Yakshas and Rakshasas, showing Krishna is the greatest of the powerful and wealthy.
candidates.evidence: वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम् (Kubera of Yakshas and Rakshasas)

candidates.angle: Meru is the highest of all mountain peaks, showing Krishna is the greatest of the high and mighty.

en.intro: The battlefield falls silent as Krishna describes the greatest of each group he represents.
en.notice: Shankara is the greatest among the fierce Rudras, Kubera is the lord of wealth among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, and Meru is the highest of all mountain peaks, showing Krishna is the greatest of each group.
en.next: Krishna moves on to the greatest of priests, commanders, and waters, to show his presence in leadership and depth.
en.meaning: Among the Rudras, I am Shankara; among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, I am Kubera. Among the Vasus, I am fire, and among mountain peaks, I am Mount Meru.

hi.intro: युद्ध का मैदान शांत हो जाता है जब कृष्ण प्रत्येक समूह के सबसे महान स्वरूप का वर्णन करते हैं।
hi.meaning: रुद्रों में शंकर, यक्ष और राक्षस में कुबेर, वसुओं में पावक अग्नि और शिखरों में मैं मेरु हूँ।
hi.notice: शंकरा रुद्रों के सबसे महान हैं, कुबेर यक्षों और राक्षसों के धन के स्वामी हैं, और मेरु सभी शिखरों में सबसे ऊँचा है, यह दर्शाता है कि कृष्ण प्रत्येक समूह के सबसे श्रेष्ठ हैं।
hi.next: कृष्ण अब पुजारियों, सेनापतियों और जल में सबसे महान का वर्णन करते हैं, जो नेतृत्व और गहराई में उनकी उपस्थिति को दर्शाते हैं।

en.intro: The battlefield falls silent as Krishna describes the greatest of each group he represents.
en.body: Among the Rudras, I am Shankara; among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, I am Kubera. Among the Vasus, I am fire, and among mountain peaks, I am Mount Meru. Shankara is the greatest among the fierce Rudras, Kubera is the lord of wealth among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, and Meru is the highest of all mountain peaks, showing Krishna is the greatest of each group. Krishna moves on to the greatest of priests, commanders, and waters, to show his presence in leadership and depth.
